items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: And we made a thing with Kenny Drew. ... We did the album together.

ctx.x: I know afterwards you made one with Tal Farlow, I think.
Yeah. 'Jarm', that was on that album. And we made a thing with Kenny Drew. Is that the one...?
Well, Kenny Drew was on the Brew Moore with J.J. thing, because he was featured on 'I'll Remember April.' That was his feature.
